title: The id is the source of consciousness, the ego is unconscious in itself

statements.text: Reversing Freud's own localization, the brainstem and limbic structures that do the work of the id are intrinsically conscious, and the cortical, declarative self that does the work of the ego is unconscious in itself. Because the ego stabilizes the id's consciousness into object representations and words, people ordinarily take themselves to be conscious in the ego's sense.

sources.quote: the declarative self, synonymous with Freud’s "ego", is unconscious in itself
To put it bluntly: consciousness is generated in the id.
